sql: select count(*) from anchor_batches where created_by = 'agent:anchor' and jsonb_array_length(leaves) = 6 and merkle_root ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and manifest_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
select count(*) from anchor_batches b, jsonb_array_elements(b.leaves) e where e->>'k' like 'plot_logs_head:%'
select count(*) from anchor_batches b, jsonb_array_elements(b.leaves) e where e->>'k' like 'qr_sig:%'
select count(*) from anchor_batches b, jsonb_array_elements(b.leaves) e where e->>'k' like 'qr_issue:%'
select count(*) from anchor_batches b, jsonb_array_elements(b.leaves) e where e->>'k' like 'qr_revoke:%'

select jsonb_array_length(leaves) = 1 + (select count(*) from qr_signatures)::int + (select count(*) from qr_codes)::int + (select count(*) from qr_codes where revoked_at is not null)::int from anchor_batches order by id desc limit 1
select count(*) from anchor_batches where leaves::text ~ 'GĐ|Thử IT|Pháp Chế|Vùng Trồng|IT-K0'
